arxiv-2110-08091.title: Semiring isomorphisms between rational function semifields of tropical curves induce isomorphisms between tropical curves
arxiv-2110-08091.creator: Song JuAe
arxiv-2110-08091.description: Abstract . We prove that a semiring isomorphism between the rational function semifields of two tropical curves induces an expansive map between those tropical curves. This semiring isomorphism and the expansive map respect zeros and poles of rational functions with their degrees.

arxiv-2112-01605.title: Optimal linear optical discrimination of Bell-like states
arxiv-2112-01605.creator: Dov Fields 1 , János A. Bergou 2,3 , Mark Hillery 2,3 , Siddhartha Santra 1 , Vladimir S. Malinovsky 1
arxiv-2112-01605.description: Abstract Quantum information processing using linear optics is challenging due to the limited set of deterministic operations achievable without using complicated resource-intensive methods. While techniques such as the use of ancillary photons can enhance the information processing capabilities of linear optical systems they are technologically demanding.

arxiv-2210-06577.title: Stability of the Néel quantum critical point in the presence of Dirac fermions
arxiv-2210-06577.creator: Huanzhi Hu, Jennifer Lin, Mikolaj D. Uryszek, Frank Krüger
arxiv-2210-06577.description: Abstract We investigate the stability of the Néel quantum critical point of two-dimensional quantum antiferromagnets, described by a non-linear σ \sigma model (NL σ \sigma M), in the presence of a Kondo coupling to N f N_{f} flavours of two-component Dirac fermion fields. The long-wavelength order parameter fluctuations are subject to Landau damping by electronic particle-hole fluctuations.

arxiv-2301-07616.title: Amenable wreath products with non almost finite actions of mean dimension zero
arxiv-2301-07616.creator: Matthieu Joseph
arxiv-2301-07616.description: Abstract . Almost finiteness was introduced in the seminal work of Kerr as an dynamical analogue of 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} -stability in the Toms-Winter conjecture. In this article, we provide the first examples of minimal, topologically free actions of amenable groups that have mean dimension zero but are not almost finite.

arxiv-2303-08620.creator: Qing Zhang, Zi-Xuan Xu, Wei Dai, Ben-Wei Zhang, Enke Wang
arxiv-2303-08620.description: Abstract Groomed jet substructure measurements, the momentum splitting fraction z g z_{g} and the groomed jet radius R g R_{g} , of inclusive, D 0 -tagged and B 0 -tagged jets in p ​ p pp and central PbPb collisions at s = 5.02 \sqrt{s}=5.02 TeV are predicted and investigated.

arxiv-2312-14388.title: A Generalized Shuffle Framework for Privacy Amplification: Strengthening Privacy Guarantees and Enhancing Utility
arxiv-2312-14388.description: Abstract The shuffle model of local differential privacy is an advanced method of privacy amplification designed to enhance privacy protection with high utility. It achieves this by randomly shuffling sensitive data, making linking individual data points to specific individuals more challenging.

arxiv-2409-13979.title: Role-Play Paradox in Large Language Models: Reasoning Performance Gains and Ethical Dilemmas
arxiv-2409-13979.creator: Jinman Zhao, Zifan Qian, Linbo Cao, Yining Wang, Yitian Ding, Yulan Hu, Zeyu Zhang, Zeyong Jin
arxiv-2409-13979.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jinman Zhao, Zifan Qian, Linbo Cao, Yining Wang, Yitian Ding, Yulan Hu, Zeyu Zhang, Zeyong Jin. Role-play in large language models (LLMs) enhances their ability to generate contextually relevant and high-quality responses by simulating diverse cognitive perspectives. However, our study identifies significant risks associated with this technique. First, we demonstrate that autotuning, a method used to auto-select models’ roles based on the question, can lead to the generation of harmful outputs, even when the model is tasked with adopting neutral roles.

arxiv-2501-18373.title: Function Encoders: A Principled Approach to Transfer Learning in Hilbert Spaces
arxiv-2501-18373.creator: Tyler Ingebrand, Adam J. Thorpe, Ufuk Topcu
arxiv-2501-18373.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tyler Ingebrand, Adam J. Thorpe, Ufuk Topcu. A central challenge in transfer learning is designing algorithms that can quickly adapt and generalize to new tasks without retraining. Yet, the conditions of when and how algorithms can effectively transfer to new tasks is poorly characterized. We introduce a geometric characterization of transfer in Hilbert spaces and define three types of inductive transfer: interpolation within the convex hull, extrapolation to the linear span, and extrapolation outside the span.

arxiv-2509-16083.creator: Xinyi Yi, Ioannis Lestas
arxiv-2509-16083.description: Abstract We address the problem of temperature regulation and optimal energy sharing in district heating systems (DHSs) where the demand and system parameters are unknown. pmc-10838173.title: ﻿On Psalmopoeus Pocock, 1895 (Araneae, Theraphosidae) species and tarantula conservation in Ecuador
pmc-10838173.creator: Pedro Peñaherrera-R., Roberto J. León-E.
pmc-10838173.description: ﻿AbstractTwo novel species of Psalmopoeus Pocock, 1895 are described from the north-western and central-western slopes of the Cordillera Occidental of the Andes mountain range in Ecuador. The new species are easily differentiated from other congeners of Psalmopoeus by spermathecae and male palpal bulb morphology and a comparatively distant distribution to the type localities of the geographically nearest known congeners.

uslaw-usc-t42-s9921.title: 42 U.S.C. § 9921 — Discretionary authority of Secretary
uslaw-usc-t42-s9921.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s9921.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 106 (Community Services Block Grant Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Grants, contracts, arrangements, loans, and guarantees (1) In general The Secretary shall, from funds reserved under section 9903(b)(3) of this title, make grants, loans, or guarantees to States and public agencies and private, nonprofit organizations, or enter into contracts.
